metadata.environment: 远程容器验证: 192.168.9.114 (Kunpeng-920 aarch64 256核 2.0Ti), openEuler 24.03 LTS-SP3 容器, Docker 18.09.0

problems_encountered.problem: UT编译失败: gmock/gmock.h not found。仓库的ros-humble-gtest-vendor 1.10.9004包仅包含gtest源码, 不含gmock。test_rack_logger_filter.cpp和test_rack_logger_filesink.cpp引用了<gmock/gmock.h>
problems_encountered.solution: 下载完整googletest 1.10.0源码(含gmock)到test/3rdparty/googletest/目录。CMakeLists.txt已有本地源码检测逻辑(IF EXISTS ${GTEST_LOCAL_VENDOR_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt), 自动使用本地源码替代vendor包下载

problems_encountered.problem: googletest 1.10.0在GCC 12.3.1下编译失败: gtest-death-test.cc中StackGrowsDown()函数的dummy变量触发-Werror=maybe-uninitialized。googletest/cmake/internal_utils.cmake中硬编码了-Werror
problems_encountered.solution: 在internal_utils.cmake的两处-Werror后添加-Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized, 放行该特定警告。这是GCC版本兼容性问题, 非代码bug

problems_encountered.problem: test_smap_handler_msg.cpp使用std::atomic<bool>但未#include <atomic>, 编译报'incomplete type'错误。gtest 1.10.0和mockcpp头文件未传递性包含<atomic>
problems_encountered.solution: 在test_smap_handler_msg.cpp第3行添加#include <atomic>(注释块之后)。这是一行缺失的include修复

problems_encountered.problem: UT执行被跳过: 宿主机Kunpeng-920内存页大小65536(64K), mockcpp通过mprotect修改代码段页属性实现API打桩, 其ARM64补丁(mockcpp_support_arm64.patch)中地址对齐宏按4K页硬编码, 64K页环境下mprotect地址未按实际页大小对齐导致调用失败, 进程向只读代码段写入指令时崩溃(SIGSEGV)
problems_encountered.solution: run_ut.sh已内置PAGESIZE检测, 非4K页环境自动跳过UT执行(exit 0)。这是mockcpp框架的已知限制, 文档已记录(doc/3rdparty_open_source_components.md 2.2节)。UT编译成功但无法在此环境执行, 需4K页环境(如容器内设置PAGE_SIZE)才能运行
